scenes.prompt: A narrow Japandi entry foyer shot straight-on with a 35mm lens at standing eye-level, square 1:1 framing, the woven-bamboo flush-mount centered in the upper third of the ceiling, its warm glow pooling in a soft halo across smooth warm-clay limewash plaster walls. The supporting light is the last of evening dusk slipping past a slim sidelight beside the dark walnut entry door at the end of the hall. Below: a low pale-oak bench with a single linen cushion, a stoneware tray holding a small ceramic dish for keys, and a tall raw-clay floor vessel cradling one bare cherry branch. The fixture matches the reference image exactly — natural bamboo woven sphere, blonde wood ceiling block, slim matte-black socket — switched ON, soft warm 2700-3000K glow filtering through the rattan weave to throw delicate diamond shadows on the ceiling. Palette: warm clay, blonde bamboo, walnut, oat linen, ink-black accent. Sharp focus, natural and photographic, no people, no cinematic moodiness.
